Literature sweep 2026-11-15 (work-6b1fa5): 11 pieces read in full by subagents, 45 findings sent to past.dev (tools/paper.py add); texts in papers/<id>.txt. Safety/alignment work excluded. Exa was down (EXA_API_KEY unset), search was plain web. Ranked for the base-vs-RL gap:
1. arxiv-2611.09382 'Exploring Weight-Space Programming' (Shanghai AI Lab, 11-06; NOT an MIT follow-up, an independent replication; code github.com/WSP-Scope/WSP-Scope-Project). One-column edit on Qwen3.5-0.8B: u = normalised (mean embedding of Wait/However/But/Maybe/Perhaps minus mean of Therefore/Thus/So/Now/The/First/Next/Let), layers.23.mlp.down_proj[:,507] -= u. MATH-500 8.35 -> 37.80; on Qwen3.5-9B 97.70 -> 97.35 (no gain where the model does not loop). Controls on 48 questions: base 6, edit 20, column ablation 4, reversed 0, equal-norm random direction 10. Three searches gave +29.45, +5.00, +27.30 points. Proposed: same u from Olmo readout rows, subtracted from the late down_proj columns where the RL delta projects most on u, a in {0.5, 1}, both signs. Refuted if cap hits fall no more than with an equal-norm random direction.
2. arxiv-2608.17124 CASE (08-17): logistic probe on the answer-token residual picks 1 of 4 samples. Qwen2.5-7B MATH-500: within-question AUC 0.763, +2.6 points over vote on hard questions (p<0.001). Needs labels on about 50 calibration questions; a naive probe is at chance within a question (0.502). Proposed: fit on base samples from 100 non-MATH-500 problems, select among our stored 4. Refuted if within-question AUC < 0.60 or it does not beat tie_short 453/500 (pass@4 is 467).
3. arxiv-2607.19331 ISO (07-21): the RL update is rotation of singular vectors, not a change of singular values; remixing inside base subspaces leaves a median 87 % of the update unexplained. Task arithmetic of two RL experts: AIME24 50.83. Proposed: U_RL S_base V_RL^T for Olmo on MATH-500. Refuted if it falls more than 2 points below RL.
4. Goodfire 'Neural Networks Are Already Clean' (10-15, web-785656d81e): neuron-level clamps change looping (zeroing outputs above the 99.9th gate percentile makes Qwen3.6-35B repeat a phrase to the cap). No code. Proposed: set the 50 late-MLP neurons with the largest RL-minus-base change to RL levels in base. Refuted if loop rate moves no more than with 50 random same-layer neurons.
5. 'Sparks of Weight-Space Programming' (web-32b3bf2b22) is the full title of the blog in knowledge-c9fc18; no separate paper. The gain is cap hits only (93.0 -> 33.1 %), so the share of base+cue errors that are cap hits is the ceiling for any loop edit: count it first. The formula W <- W - 6u(u^T W) in knowledge-c1fe13 is not in the blog text.
Lower: arxiv-2509.01363 Reasoning Vectors (GRPO-minus-SFT vector, Qwen2.5-7B GSM8K 55.3 -> 58.9, cue adds on top: 60.3; agrees with our theta result). arxiv-2608.19611 Forking Fast (Goodfire; locates the token where an outcome becomes fixed, code released; use on loop onsets). arxiv-2605.26172 ARBITER (MATH-500 Qwen3-4B vote 69.20, top-2 oracle 76.60; hidden-state rerank and self-review fragile, agrees with result-96e819). arxiv-2607.18100 SOPHIA (loop-exit steering vector, no accuracy reported). Goodfire parameter decomposition (web-4043a8cbfa): 67M-parameter model only, 400,000 steps, not usable at 7B. Goodfire Manifold Steering arxiv-2605.05115: no accuracy evidence.
Not verified: Olmo MLP activation type (decides whether Goodfire's SwiGLU findings apply); no repo opened.
